# TALO_API.md — Talo Rust Server API Reference

This document summarizes the HTTP and WebSocket API shapes for the Talo-compatible Rust backend. Use this as the canonical reference when implementing endpoints. Where shapes are incomplete, TODO markers indicate verification needed against the original Talo TypeScript server.

All request/response JSON examples use snake_case keys for Rust serde default (use `serde(rename_all = "camelCase")` if you prefer camelCase to match TypeScript).

---

## Authentication

### POST /auth/login
Request:
```json
{
  "username": "sample_user",
  "password": "secure_pass"
}
```
Response (200):
```json
{
  "token": "<JWT_TOKEN>",
  "expiry": 3600
}
```
Errors:
- 401 Unauthorized — invalid credentials

Rust serde struct examples:
```rust
use serde::{Serialize, Deserialize};

#[derive(Deserialize)]
pub struct LoginRequest {
    pub username: String,
    pub password: String,
}

#[derive(Serialize)]
pub struct LoginResponse {
    pub token: String,
    pub expiry: i64,
}
```

## Players

### GET /players/{id}
Response (200):
```json
{
  "id": "player123",
  "username": "sample_user",
  "email": "user@example.com",
  "status": "online",
  "parent_account_id": null
}
```

### POST /players
Request:
```json
{
  "username": "new_player",
  "email": "new@example.com",
  "password": "secure_pass",
  "parent_account_id": null
}
```
Response (201):
```json
{ "id": "player124", "status": "created" }
```

Rust serde structs:
```rust
#[derive(Serialize, Deserialize, sqlx::FromRow)]
pub struct Player {
    pub id: String,
    pub username: String,
    pub email: Option<String>,
    pub status: String,
    pub parent_account_id: Option<String>,
}

#[derive(Deserialize)]
pub struct CreatePlayerRequest {
    pub username: String,
    pub email: Option<String>,
    pub password: String,
    pub parent_account_id: Option<String>,
}
```

## Leaderboards

### GET /leaderboards/{game_id}
Query params: `?limit=50&offset=0`
Response (200):
```json
{
  "game_id": "game123",
  "entries": [
    { "player_id": "player1", "score": 1000, "rank": 1 },
    { "player_id": "player2", "score": 950, "rank": 2 }
  ]
}
```

### POST /leaderboards/{game_id}/entries
Request:
```json
{ "player_id": "player1", "score": 1100 }
```
Response (201):
```json
{ "status": "ok", "new_rank": 1 }
```

Rust structs:
```rust
#[derive(Serialize, Deserialize, sqlx::FromRow)]
pub struct LeaderboardEntry {
    pub game_id: String,
    pub player_id: String,
    pub score: i64,
    pub timestamp: chrono::DateTime<chrono::Utc>,
}

#[derive(Deserialize)]
pub struct SubmitScoreRequest {
    pub player_id: String,
    pub score: i64,
}
```

Notes:
- Ranking should be computed in SQL for performance. Consider using `ROW_NUMBER()` over partition.

## Game Saves

### POST /saves
Request:
```json
{ "player_id": "player1", "save": { /* arbitrary JSON */ }, "metadata": { "zone": "level1" } }
```
Response (201):
```json
{ "save_id": "save123", "status": "created" }
```

### GET /saves/{player_id}
Response (200): list of saves

Rust structs:
```rust
#[derive(Serialize, Deserialize, sqlx::FromRow)]
pub struct GameSave {
    pub save_id: String,
    pub player_id: String,
    pub save_blob: serde_json::Value,
    pub metadata: Option<serde_json::Value>,
    pub created_at: chrono::DateTime<chrono::Utc>,
}

#[derive(Deserialize)]
pub struct CreateSaveRequest {
    pub player_id: String,
    pub save: serde_json::Value,
    pub metadata: Option<serde_json::Value>,
}
```

Notes:
- Ensure DB column for `save_blob` is `JSON` (MySQL/Postgres) and supports large objects. Consider chunking if > max packet size.

## WebSocket `/ws`

The WebSocket connection is used for real-time game channels. Clients connect with a query param or header containing the JWT token for auth, then send/receive JSON messages.

Connection example:
```
ws://example.com/ws?token=<JWT>
```

Common message types (JSON envelope):
```json
{ "type": "presence", "action": "join", "player_id": "player1", "channel": "global" }
{ "type": "chat", "channel": "global", "from": "player1", "message": "hello" }
{ "type": "event", "channel": "game:123", "event": { "tick": 1, "payload": {...} } }
```

Rust message enums:
```rust
use serde::{Serialize, Deserialize};

#[derive(Serialize, Deserialize)]
#[serde(tag = "type")]
pub enum WsClientMessage {
    #[serde(rename = "presence")]
    Presence { action: String, player_id: String, channel: String },
    #[serde(rename = "chat")]
    Chat { channel: String, from: String, message: String },
    #[serde(rename = "event")]
    Event { channel: String, event: serde_json::Value },
}

#[derive(Serialize, Deserialize)]
#[serde(tag = "type")]
pub enum WsServerMessage {
    #[serde(rename = "presence")] 
    PresenceUpdate { channel: String, players: Vec<String> },
    #[serde(rename = "chat")] 
    ChatMsg { channel: String, from: String, message: String },
    #[serde(rename = "error")] 
    Error { code: String, message: String },
}
```

## Error Format

Standardize on an error response envelope:
```json
{ "error": { "code": "invalid_input", "message": "username is required", "details": { "field": "username" } } }
```
Rust helper:
```rust
#[derive(Serialize)]
pub struct ApiError<'a> {
    pub error: ApiErrorBody<'a>,
}

#[derive(Serialize)]
pub struct ApiErrorBody<'a> {
    pub code: &'a str,
    pub message: &'a str,
    pub details: Option<serde_json::Value>,
}
```
